notes.title: Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ)
notes.content:
Modern Warships on Steam 

🟦 What is Modern Warships?

Modern Warships is a cross-platform arcade online action game where modern naval battles look like they do in reality.
Surveillance aircraft rush forward to detect the enemy from distance.
Cruisers launch volleys of guided missiles and try to reset enemy missile defences.
Submarines sneak up to surface vessels and jet fighters provide cover to the allied fleet from the air.

🟦 When will the game be released on Steam?

We are pushing our best to have it in your hands by 2025

🟦 What platforms and control devices will it support?

We aim to support PC & Steam Deck on Steam version as part of releasing our game on Steam. Players will of course be able to use their mobile phones and tablets with the mobile version of the game to enjoy cross-platform gameplay in Modern Warships.
Mobile phones & tablets, mouse & keyboard, and Steam Deck will be first-class citizens, but we can't possibly support all the controllers in the world.
Users may try using gamepads and joysticks; support for most devices is planned for the game's release.

🟦 How much does it cost to play?

Modern Warships is Free to Play!

🟦 What will Steam users benefit from Modern Warships on Steam?

There will be Steam Achievements and Collectible Cards for skilled and resourceful commanders.
We also plan to release unique items at the launch of the Steam version.

🟦 Will battles be separated by device/platform?

As with all truly cross-platform games, players of different devices will compete in the same battlefield, regardless of device.

🟦 Will I be able to transfer my progress from the mobile version to Steam?

Absolutely. Being cross-platform means you can play anywhere, anytime, on your choice of device.

🟦 Does the game support 'modding'?

We neither provide nor support any form of modding. Instead, we aim to deliver a fine-tuned, optimized, top-quality game build, playable on all our supported platforms.

🟦 How do I join the testing of new updates?

We will make an official announcement when we start open beta testing.
Detailed instructions will be given there.
Stay tuned for official updates!


 Core Game Play 

🟦 Is internet connection required?

Yes, Modern Warships keeps a farm of servers that power the game experience of hundreds of millions(?) of users. Even for 'Offline modes', which we will describe later, we require internet connection.

🟦 Is it possible to play with friends?

Of course, we plan to offer various functions to add (or sometimes block...) friends.
We even award squad plays through Daily Missions, and honestly the surest road (or shall we say, seaway) to victory is by squadding with friends!
We also plan to offer Custom Game modes, where you can play 'against' friends - both for fun and even for titles.
We will elabore more on this through a separate article.

🟦 Will there be clans in the game?

There will not only be clans, but also

 Clan chats
 Clan leaderboards
 Clan tournaments
 Top clan awards


🟦 What consumables are available for use in battle?

We will provide the following consumables for ship captains to stay relevant in battle:

 Missile Countermeasures
 Repair kit
 Ammunition Reserve
 Aircraft Missile Decoy
 Torpedo Countermeasures
 Engine Boost
 Oxygen Reserve
 Smoke Screen
 Electronic Warfare
 Air Electronic Warfare


🟦 What will the Battle HUD look like?

The battle HUD will feature your ship/aircraft in a third person's view, with controls for

 Maneuver
 Armament firing
 Consumable usage
 PoV switching between ships and deployed aircrafts/vessels
 Radar (aka 'minimap')
 Unit info & stats (damage counters, oxygen, reload points, etc.)
 Alerts & messages (for detection, target lock-on, incoming threats, etc.)
 Battle info (timer, points, no. of kills, checkpoints, etc.)

There are two very important aspects we aim to deliver:

 Battle HUD will be optimized to the type of device. Mobile devices will have an HUD that makes optimal use of their compact screens, while PC users will benefit from a spacious yet user friendly layout which can maximize battle efficiency.
 Battle HUD can be customized by device. Lefties? Check. One hand players? Check. Foldable phones and tables? Check!

More details will be available in future articles, so stay tuned!

🟦 What languages is the game translated into?

(deep breath) Here goes:

 Arabic
 Chinese (Simplified)
 Chinese (Traditional)
 Dutch
 English
 Filipino
 French
 German
 Greek
 Hindi
 Indonesian
 Italian
 Japanese
 Korean
 Malay
 Polish
 Portuguese
 Portuguese (Brazil)
 Russian
 Spanish
 Spanish (Castilian)
 Thai
 Turkish
 Vietnamese
 Ukranian


🟦 What perks are there to help new users adopt to the game? 

We are making everything to make new users boost their fleet and inventories!

 Step-by-step tutorials
 Exclusive new user events
 Monthly Battle Passes
 Vault Passes for off-season passes
 Monthly major events
 Bi-monthly community events

and many more!


 Modern Warships' Items 

🟦 What are the types of ships in Modern Warships? 

Here's a list of what we've prepared so far.
We are also fully open to adding new ship classes if it may bring modern, realistic & interesting naval battles at your fingertips!

 Corvettes
 Frigates
 Destroyers
 Cruisers
 Battleships
 Aircraft Carriers
 Assault Aircraft Carriers
 Assault Landing Ships
 Submarines
 Ekranoplans
 Hovercrafts


🟦 What are the types of ship-deployable units in Modern Warships? 

No navy goes to battle without air support.
Not only aircraft carriers, but also some ships, will be designed to equip:

 Helicopters
 Fighters
 Strike Fighters
 Drones
 Bombers
 Unmanned Vessels
 Unmanned Submarines
 Unmanned Hovercrafts


🟦 What types of equipment can ships/aircrafts have?

Plenty!

 Cannons: artilleries, railguns, rapid fire small calibres, etc.
 Missile Batteries: anti-ship/air/sub, laser-guided, heat-seeking, cluster munitions, sea skimming, ballistic, arc trajectory etc.
 Grenade Launchers: unguided, laser guided, heat-seeking, and of course, anti-ship/air/sub
 Torpedoes: light, heavy, supercavitation, nuclear warheads(!)
 Air Defenses: CIWS, VLS, Laser, hybrid
 Auto-cannons: anti-ship/air/sub, long-range, medium-range


🟦 How would one go about upgrading these ships and items?

The game will provide means to acquire & purchase "Upgrade points", with which the player can upgrade his ship and equipment.
Upgrade points will be made available from shops, Battle Passes, Events, and as other various awards.

🟦 What items will you provide for players to 'express' themselves?

Apart from battle-related items, we also plan to offer 'costmetics':

 Camouflages, available to equip on any ship
 Skins, exclusively optimized for a single ship
 Flags of countries, cultural/fictional symbols, and even memes!
 Titles, comprised of a few words to show (verify) the title owner's uniqueness
 Avatars, to put on the player profile page, and display it throughout all the game, including battle stats, leaderboards, chatrooms, etc.



 Modern Warships' Modes and Maps 

🟦 What game modes will be available?

By battle mechanism, we will prepare five major game modes:

 Team Deathmatch: Two teams fight against each other within a limited timeframe. Win by destroying your opponents.
 Domination: Battle for control points. The victory goes to the team that either destroys enemies first or captures the points.
 Deathmatch: All participants in the match fight each other. The winner is the one who destroys the largest number of opponents in the allotted time.
 Escort: Two teams are fighting for the cargo. The goal of the escort team is to deliver the cargo to the port, the goal of the interception team is to destroy it. The team that completes its goal first - wins.
 Tandem Wars: Battle of 4 teams of 2 players. The team that scores the maximum number of points in the allotted time wins.

These modes will be available as

 Offline games, with bots as allies and enemies
 Online games, matched with individual or squadrons randomly, and
 Custom games, designed for invitation-only, for all sorts of venues (fun modes, chill rooms, and even tournaments!)

Some modes will be limited exclusively for:

 Time-limited, Event modes
 Season-limited Ranked modes


🟦 Are there any restrictions to squad players? 

While we try to provide a battle environment where all players can compete fairly, we also do not want to restrict their freedom completely.

In general, players will be able to play in squads of up to 5 people on any platform available at the time of release, and squad mates do not necessarily have to be in the same platform to play together.

There is of course an obvious restriction - squad plays are not available for 'offline' games :)

🟦 What maps will we be playing on? 

Scenes can take place in any part of the world imaginable - hot tropical archipelago, snowy expanses of the Arctic, pitch black storm amidst oil rigs, stone ridges with narrow escapes, post-nuclear ruins above toppled cities, etc.

In numbers, there will be 14 maps(!) available for our main game mode, Team Death Match.
Other game modes will feature some of these maps to suit the battle mechanics and terrain requirements.

For example, Domination mode requires strategic points sufficiently spread out with debris, while Deathmatch and Escort modes needs carefully designed paths and safety zones to balance the tension.
Stay tuned for more news, as we plan to release a separate article that deep-dives into all the battle scenes of Modern Warships!

notes.title: Development Diaries | Ships & Equipment
notes.content:
Commanders, we continue sharing the development progress of the Steam version of Modern Warships. At this stage, we're excited to show you some of the new ships and equipment currently in preparation. All of these items will be available at launch — along with many more ships and modules!

🛳️ Helicopter Cruiser IT Vittorio Veneto (C550)
Nation: Italy
Tier: III
Role: ASW and helicopter support
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45464388/f409afeadfcae29a6cb8d47332385d2092da2b9e.jpg
A legendary vessel and former flagship of the Italian Navy. Equipped with powerful missile systems, two helicopter slots, modern electronics, a unique 76mm gun with explosive shells, and advanced air defense — including a 40mm autocannon and an upgraded RIM-67 SAM system.

🛳️ Helicopter Cruiser FS Jeanne d’Arc
Nation: France
Tier: III
Role: Active maneuvers and strike raids
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45464388/f35d7eb20a88c720b27bb61303fd73cd3567907e.jpg
A multi-purpose platform of the French Navy, combining the roles of a training ship and combat-ready unit. Features MM40 Block 3c anti-ship missiles, a CADAM Model 64 dual-purpose gun (100mm), and Sea-Ceptor JD air defense system. Agile, flexible, and capable of carrying up to three helicopters.

🛳️ Experimental Destroyer HMS Paladin (D200)
Nation: United Kingdom
Tier: III
Role: Tactical control and long-range damage
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45464388/2ed5863a176beb239bef53f46764c7e2d0800a00.jpg
A modern British Navy destroyer with high survivability and customizable loadout. Armed with a unique electromagnetic railgun for long-range strikes and the Aster 30 Block 2 SAM system for anti-air defense. Includes multiple open slots for missiles, autocannon, grenade launcher, helicopter, and additional AA systems.

🛩️ Strike Fighter F-4S Phantom II
Nation: USA
Tier: III
Role: Heavy air-to-surface damage
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45464388/f8746e7c371b4fa93d2a9ff87222775bd73096d8.jpg
An upgraded version of the F-4 with an extended arsenal: AGM-78 and AGM-45 missiles, a GBU-15 glide bomb, and AIM-9L air-to-air missiles — making it a versatile threat to both ships and aircraft.

🚁 Helicopter Wildcat HMA 2
Nation: United Kingdom
Tier: III
Role: Flexible airstrike and close-range AA
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45464388/13b57f97ed9847302a59c4211b8b22523257be1f.jpg
A maneuverable assault helicopter with weapons for both ship and air targets, including the unique STARstreak air defense system for close-range threats.

🚀 IDAS Missile
Nation: Germany
Tier: III
Role: First anti-air missile for submarines
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45464388/3185be210d09f227dfbef1d08ed0f1a2a0e8ac57.jpg
A one-of-a-kind mid-range missile launched from underwater. Allows submarines to strike both air and surface targets. While its warhead is modest, it boasts a very short launch preparation time.

✈️ Fighter Tornado F.Mk.3
Nation: United Kingdom
Tier: III
Role: High-speed interceptor and air superiority
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45464388/5d0e014789354333843a35259cacd27bed8a1afe.jpg
An all-weather fighter with variable-sweep wings and excellent high-speed maneuverability. Armed with the DEFA 552 gun and Sky Flash missiles for precise multi-angle target interception.

Mark 55/12 Naval Gun (305mm)
Nation: USA
Tier: III
Role: Massive long-range damage
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45464388/785e1c34d74504cabd5b902c2c8392d2850c0887.jpg
A prototype 305mm single-barrel naval gun from the U.S. Navy. Delivers devastating long-range shots against surface targets. Slow to reload and turn, but immensely powerful.

HyFly-2 Missile (Nuclear Warhead)
Nation: USA
Tier: III
Role: Precision-guided area damage
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45464388/a7862e12671f7d57552dad6b01c6274ca71d028b.jpg
An American hypersonic cruise missile project with a nuclear payload and laser guidance. Designed to engage targets at extreme range.

RapidFire LMM Autocannon
Nation: France
Tier: III
Role: Hybrid air defense
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45464388/b02d4dabf9d1aa56a8fcd1f841044f09f34cc014.jpg
A unique blend of LMM missiles and rapid-fire autocannon in a single RAPIDFire unit. Automatically selects optimal ammo types in real time to counter a wide range of airborne threats.

And this is just a glimpse of what’s coming to Modern Warships on Steam. Stay tuned — more ships, features, and surprises are on the horizon!

⚓ See you at sea!

notes.title: Ship Classes in Modern Warships
notes.content:
In Modern Warships, there’s a ship class for every playstyle — whether you're a tactical commander, a fast-moving flank predator, an unstoppable artillery machine, or a lover of aerial combat. Let’s explore each ship class available in the game and what they feel like in real combat.

⚓ Corvette
Agile Entry-Level Fighter
 Small, fast, and armed with basic weaponry — corvettes are designed for newcomers taking their first steps in Modern Warships. They let you learn the ropes without overwhelming complexity.
💡Tier: I-II
♟Role: Training and light support
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45464388/7613b5d16e1930c22a17801eadb428a8f20b9ec3.jpg
USS Hurricane (T1)

🔭 Frigate
Eyes and Ears of the Fleet
 With excellent speed and compact design, frigates are ideal for reconnaissance and quick hit-and-run attacks. Just don’t get caught in a prolonged fight — this class is built for tactical strikes.
💡Tier: II-III
♟Role:  Recon, flanking
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45464388/7d45051162ebab7c70285a97b587df880ff68df3.jpg
RF Breeze (T2)

⚔ Destroyer
Balanced Powerhouse
 The most versatile class in the game. Destroyers suit both new players and veterans, thanks to their balanced stats, flexible tactics, and wide range of weapons.
💡Tier: II-III
♟Role:  All-round combat
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45464388/eba5019d00ce10466f1634bf67a85e7540829efe.jpg
CN Type 055A (T3)

🛡 Cruiser
The Armored Wall
 Slow but tough. Cruisers boast powerful air defense, high durability, and enhanced vision range. Perfect for slow, deliberate advances and area control.
💡Tier: III 
♟Role:  Defense, artillery push
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45464388/3e268e7e69f63f01b355324e70548bb6a5880e88.jpg
USS Long Beach (CGN-9) (T3)

💥 Battleship
Heavy Caliber Might
 Love dishing out massive damage? Battleships are your go-to. Equipped with huge guns and thick armor, they dominate in close-range engagements.
💡Tier: III 
♟Role:   Artillery assault
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45464388/222a1255531605e2e84f52e21de5d28e8495a86f.jpg
JS Yamato Aegis (T3) in the legendary Midnight Vanquisher skin

✈ Aircraft Carrier
Air Commander
 Launch drones, fighters, helicopters, and strike aircraft — carriers bring an entire air force to the fight. Manual control over each unit adds strategic depth and variety.
💡Tier: II-III
♟Role:  Air support
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45464388/5d1ebdfeb38b011985cb2dc57089f9d57260f81e.jpg
INS Vikrant (IAC-I) (T3)

☢ Assault Carrier
Carrier on Steroids
 More weapons, more aircraft, and a dedicated slot for bombers — and that’s just the beginning. Perfect for players who want to wreak havoc from the skies.
💡Tier: III 
♟Role:  Heavy air support
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45464388/93e1f298139b92ed8aa709db106f57f964b3623f.jpg
FS PANG (T3)

🐋 Submarine
Master of Stealth and Survival
 Dive to disappear, surface to strike. Submarines are perfect for hunting high-value targets and turning the tide in late-game scenarios. A true carrier killer.
💡Tier: II-III
♟Role:  Stealth assault
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45464388/9d6c25f4f19eba119a59e724ea0f5ca565b1b7cd.jpg
CN Type 100 (T3)

🚀 Ekranoplan
Speed Above All
 Skims over water at breakneck speed while unleashing a storm of missiles. Ideal for flanking attacks and overwhelming enemy AA defenses.
💡Tier: II-III
♟Role:  Breakthrough, distraction
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45464388/5ec0fdfe36dcad835fcdf2512bb1bea5ab281046.jpg
RF Loon (T2)

🐙 Assault Landing Ship
The Ultimate Multi-Tool
 Carries drones, autonomous surface and underwater units — and sometimes even aircraft. Ideal for players who want to control multiple combat layers at once.
💡Tier: III 
♟Role:  Hybrid support
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45464388/7eb31be04cace680ad175749a3fbe120bc687869.jpg
JS Katori (T3)

🌀 Hovercraft
The Silent Bite
 Small, nimble, and deadly. Hovercraft are built for stealth missions and lightning-fast attacks in shallow waters.
💡Tier: III 
♟Role:  Rapid strike, mobile support
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45464388/d7b160969fc544f4f4477a503f7df534f4b7583a.jpg
Pan Spatial Zeus (T3)


🚢 Choose your style. Prepare for battle.
Each class in Modern Warships is more than just a ship — it’s a whole combat philosophy.
From stealthy submarine strikes to overwhelming air raids from assault carriers — you decide how to fight.

💬 Which class is your favorite? Let us know in the comments — and don’t forget to add the game to your wishlist. The Steam release is coming soon!
